operations.title: Benincasa retypes the common block-one term as a graph functional
operations.body: Sharper exact statement: projection of the full 26-dimensional strict residual space to normal block 0 has rank 26 and kernel 0. Therefore the unique common block-one term is not an independent attachment/class; the residual module is the graph of a linear functional over R_{1,0} direct-sum R_{2,0}. In the frozen source basis that functional is supported only on (T1,index6) and (T2,index6), value 10 on each. For the K5 adapter, test commutation with block-zero projection and transport of this graph functional separately. A new pure higher-block kernel would be genuinely new behavior; loss of the degree-14 coordinate alone would not imply loss of a class if the graph is rewritten in the enlarged basis.

authority_basis.summary: Correcting the categorical interpretation of a verified finite residual term before the active adapter test.
